name: Calm Barrier Cream
spoken: a fragrance-free soothing cream that supports the skin barrier
routine: Use it morning and night after cleansing.

name: Daily Mineral SPF 50
spoken: a mineral sunscreen that is gentle on sensitive skin
routine: Apply every morning as the last step, and reapply if you stay outside.

name: Hydra Gel Serum
spoken: a lightweight hydrating serum with hyaluronic acid
routine: Pat two drops onto damp skin, then follow with moisturizer.

name: Oil Balance Gel Moisturizer
spoken: an oil-free gel moisturizer for shine control
routine: Use a pea-sized amount in the morning, focusing on the forehead and nose.

name: Gentle BHA Toner
spoken: a mild exfoliating toner for pores and uneven texture
routine: Start two or three evenings a week, not every day.

name: Spot Care Gel
spoken: a small tube of gel you dab only on blemishes
routine: Dab a thin layer on blemishes at night.

name: Bright Eye Cream
spoken: a gentle eye cream with caffeine
routine: Tap a rice-sized amount under each eye, morning and night.
